parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Separate multiple cluster IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。多个集群ID间用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en: The Agentic cluster ID. Separate multiple cluster IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: Agentic 集群 ID。多个集群 ID 间用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: agentic_db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en: The cluster description. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.name: db_cluster_description

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100.

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值为 30、50 或 100。

默认值为 30
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The tag value that corresponds to the tag key
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The tag key. You can use tags to filter clusters. You can specify up to 20 tags. The number n for each tag pair must be unique and must be a consecutive integer that starts from 1. The Tag.n.Key parameter is paired with the Tag.n.Value parameter
fields.help_zh: 标签键，可以根据标签过滤集群列表。最多20对标签，各个标签对的数字n必须不同，且必须是从1开始的连续整数。Tag.n.Key对应的值为Tag.n.Value
fields.name: key

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call. If there is no next query, do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（token），取值为上一次api调用返回的nexttoken参数值。如果没有下一个查询，请不传
parameters.name: next_token

Category.description_en:
The cluster edition. Valid values:

Normal: Cluster Edition

Basic: Single Node Edition

Archive: X-Engine Edition

NormalMultimaster: Multi-master Cluster (Database/Table)
Category.description_zh:
集群系列，目前支持如下系列：

Normal：集群版

Basic：单节点

Archive：高压缩引擎（X-Engine）

NormalMultimaster：多主集群（库表）

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the cluster was created.

The time is in the ISO 8601 format in UTC (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ)
CreateTime.description_zh:
集群创建时间。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式，时区为 UTC（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the cluster.
A specific value is returned only for clusters whose billing method is Prepaid (subscription). An empty value is returned for Postpaid (pay-as-you-go) clusters.

The time is in the ISO 8601 format in UTC (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ)
ExpireTime.description_zh:
集群到期时间。
仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群会返回具体参数值，Postpaid（按量付费）集群则返回空值。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式，时区为 UTC（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

Expired.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster has expired. Valid values:

true

false

This parameter is returned only for clusters whose billing method is Prepaid (subscription)
Expired.description_zh:
集群是否到期。取值范围：

true

false

仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群支持返该参数

LockMode.description_en:
The lock status of the cluster. Valid values: 

Unlock: Normal. 
ManualLock: manually locked. 
LockByExpiration: automatically locked due to cluster expiration
LockMode.description_zh:
集群的锁定状态，取值范围如下： 

Unlock：正常。 
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。 
LockByExpiration：集群过期自动锁定

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values: 

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型。取值范围： 

Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：包年包月（预付费）。

ScaleMax.description_en: The maximum value: 1 to 32 PCUs. Unit: PCU

ScaleMin.description_en: The minimum value: 0 to 32 PCUs. The minimum value must be less than or equal to the maximum value. Unit: PCU
ScaleMin.description_zh: 最小值:0~32 PCU，且最小值 <= 最大值。单位：PCU

ServerlessType.description_en: The serverless type. A return value of AgileServerless indicates that the cluster is a serverless cluster
ServerlessType.description_zh: Serverless类型。返回AgileServerless表示当前集群是Serverless集群

StorageType.description_en:
The storage type. Valid values:
essdpl0
essdpl1
essdpl2
essdpl3
StorageType.description_zh:
存储类型取值如下：
essdpl0
essdpl1
essdpl2
essdpl3

StorageUsed.description_en: The storage usage of the cluster. Unit: bytes
StorageUsed.description_zh: 集群已经使用的存储用量，单位为Byte

Tags.description_en: The tag key. You can use tags to filter clusters. You can specify up to 20 tags. The number n for each tag pair must be unique and must be a consecutive integer that starts from 1. The Tag.n.Key parameter is paired with the Tag.n.Value parameter
Tags.description_zh: 标签键，可以根据标签过滤集群列表。最多20对标签，各个标签对的数字n必须不同，且必须是从1开始的连续整数。Tag.n.Key对应的值为Tag.n.Value

items.description_en: The tag key. You can use tags to filter clusters. You can specify up to 20 tags. The number n for each tag pair must be unique and must be a consecutive integer that starts from 1. The Tag.n.Key parameter is paired with the Tag.n.Value parameter
items.description_zh: 标签键，可以根据标签过滤集群列表。最多20对标签，各个标签对的数字n必须不同，且必须是从1开始的连续整数。Tag.n.Key对应的值为Tag.n.Value

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) in which the endpoint resides
VpcId.description_zh: 访问端点所在的专有网络ID

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Default value: 10
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量，默认值为10

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call. If there is no next query, do not specify this parameter
NextToken.description_zh: 查询凭证（token），取值为上一次api调用返回的nexttoken参数值。如果没有下一个查询，请不传
